Noah (Growth): Heads-up team — we need a compact asset pack for next Wednesday's webinar + inbound pages. Core story: benchmark comparisons (hosted vs dedicated vs private) focusing on latency, unit cost, and graceful fallbacks. Can design take asset prioritization? :eyes:
Maya (Design): I can own this. Quick check: hero format preference — static, animated, or both?
Noah (Growth): Both ideally but prioritize static hero + 3 micro-tiles. Animation only if it won't delay the launch. Need 16:9 webinar hero + 1:1 social.
Priya (Content): Messaging to pair: "Serving wins: predictable latency, lower unit costs, resilient fallbacks." Need a short statset (p95 latency numbers, token cost delta). I'll send numbers in ~1h.
Maya (Design): Any brand constraints for chart styles or iconography? New colors?
BrandBot: Reminder — follow Brand Guideline v2.1. Use accent-blue-500 for accents and neutral-800 for text. Avoid gradients on benchmark charts; prefer 2-color palettes for comparisons.
Maya (Design): Got it. I'll explore three visual directions (data-led, illustration-led, and hybrid) and share mocks by EOD.
Evan (PM): Also need a single-slide routing diagram: policy flow like "low latency -> hosted; cost-optimized -> dedicated/private; fallback chain". Annotate with autoscaling, KV cache, quantization profile. Keep it minimal.
Maya (Design): Routing diagram noted. Short labels only. Do you want arrows showing automatic fallback?
Evan (PM): Yes, show automatic fallback and a callout for SLA-bound tiers.
Devon (Analytics): Micro-tiles should each include a tiny sparkline and one primary stat: p95 latency, tokens/sec, or per-token cost. I'll export sparkline SVGs and raw numbers at 2:45pm.
Maya (Design): Perfect. Export presets I'll prepare: PNG for web, SVG for charts/diagrams, and MP4 for animation if used.
Priya (Content): I'll draft alt text for each image and a 1-line CTA for social. Also writing a longer methodology caption for the webinar landing page.
Maya (Design): Accessibility checklist: contrast ratios, keyboard focus order, and alt text — will add as Figma comments. Priya, can you vet the alt text?
Priya (Content): Yep. Also suggest the hero headline: "Serving wins: performance that scales" — shorter and punchy.
Noah (Growth): Love that headline. If timelines slip, cut the animation and one social variant.
Maya (Design): Timeline proposal: mockups by 5pm today, final exports by Tuesday 9am. Is that acceptable?
Noah (Growth): Works for me. I'll route final assets to demand gen and comms.
Devon (Analytics): FYI one micro-tile will call out a dedicated+quantized model variant — note that in the micro-caption.
Maya (Design): Noted — I'll leave a small star and add a micro-caption: "*dedicated quantized configuration".
Priya (Content): After assets are final, I'll hand off the one-paragraph narrative + speaker bios for the webinar page.
Maya (Design): Sharing initial Figma link when ready. Will post three mock directions for quick feedback.
Noah (Growth): Please tag me on the mock post so I can consolidate feedback before design review.
Maya (Design): Figma upload: https://redwood.app/figma/xyz789 — mocks A/B/C up. Leave comments there.
Priya (Content): Reviewing now. Minor edit: change hero copy to "Serving wins: performance that scales" and shorten CTA to "Register — see the benchmark".
Devon (Analytics): Dropping final metric numbers at 14:45 PST. Expect p95s and per-token deltas vs hosted baseline.
Maya (Design): Thanks. I'll plug numbers into the micro-tiles and prep final export presets. Accessibility notes pinned in Figma.
Noah (Growth): Great progress — if any blockers, escalate to #design-ops. Thanks team :thumbsup:
